data.description:
# Review and improve the 100-sound recipe book — Intake Brief

**Work Item:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH | **Type:** docs | **Priority:** Medium

> **Headline:** Review the existing `docs/recipe-book/` (index + 100 recipe pages +
> 10 capstone pages), fix its broken links and invalid CLI commands at the
> generator source, and add a "Working with the CLI" section to the index that
> shows how to **find**, **evaluate** and **understand how these sounds were
> created** — backed by tests that keep the book honest.

## Problem statement

The casual-game recipe book already exists (`docs/recipe-book/`), but it has
never been reviewed end-to-end and contains correctness defects and a content
gap: 121 broken relative links, an invalid `toneforge show` command repeated on
all 100 recipe pages, tests that only check for marker presence rather than
block freshness or link validity, and no CLI-workflow guidance in the index. As
a result a reader cannot reliably move from "I want a sound" to finding,
auditioning and understanding it using the documented commands.

## Users

- **Game developers** prototyping casual/arcade games who need to discover and
  audition the 100-sound library from the CLI.
- **Sound designers / technical artists** reading each recipe page to understand
  how a sound was built and how to vary it.
- **ToneForge maintainers** who need the book to stay mechanically in sync with
  the recipes and generators.

Example user stories:

- As a developer, I want a single page that tells me how to find a sound by
  keyword/category/tag and audition it, so I do not have to piece commands
  together from several demos.
- As a sound designer, I want the CLI commands on a recipe page to actually run,
  so I can trust the book as a reference.
- As a maintainer, I want the test suite to fail when a link breaks or a CLI
  block goes stale, so the book cannot silently drift.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All local relative links in `docs/recipe-book/` resolve: a link-integrity check
  (new or extended) passes for `index.md`, `_template.md`, all 100 recipe pages
  and all 10 capstone pages, with zero broken local targets.
- Every CLI command shown in the book is valid: `toneforge show --recipe <name>`
  is replaced by the correct positional form (`toneforge show <name>`) on all 100
  recipe pages, and the generators that emit it are corrected so a regeneration
  produces the same, valid output (second run byte-identical).
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` gains a **Working with the CLI** section covering
  **find** (`list recipes` with `--search`/`--category`/`--tags`/`--json`,
  `show`, `library list`/`library search`), **evaluate** (`generate`, `play`,
  `analyze`, `classify`, `explore`, `visualize`, `tui`) and **understand how
  they were created** (`show`, the page's `## Sound design` section,
  `presets/recipes/*.yaml`, the ToneGraph schema/node-kind index) — with
  copy-paste commands, and linked from `README.md` § Documentation.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` enforces **real** CLI-block freshness
  (regenerate and compare, not just marker presence) and link integrity, and the
  capstone CLI blocks carry machine-readable markers so they are covered too.
- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
  comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Fix the generators, not the pages.** Correct `scripts/recipe-book/*.ts` and
  regenerate `docs/recipe-book/*`; hand-editing generated pages is out of scope.
  Regeneration must remain idempotent (second run byte-identical).
- **No change to recipe content or architecture** — the recipe YAML, roster,
  registry and sound design are untouched.
- **Preserve the book's conventions** — front matter (`title`/`id`/`order`/
  `description`), roster order, tier structure and all existing green gates.
- **UK English** throughout.
- The tier-aware per-page CLI blocks (progressive tooling) are **out of scope**
  and tracked as follow-up **TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX**.

## Existing state

- `docs/recipe-book/` contains `index.md`, `_template.md`, one page per recipe
  (100) and one page per capstone (10).
- `scripts/recipe-book/` contains `generate-index.ts`, `generate-pages.ts`,
  `generate-cli-blocks.ts`, `generate-capstones.ts` and `recipe-meta.ts`.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` gates schema validity, determinism,
  non-silence, page presence, index order, tags and marker presence — but
  **not** block freshness or links.
- `README.md` links the book from § Documentation.
- Verified defects: `../../tonegraph.md` on 101 pages (file is
  `docs/tonegraph.md`); `../../prd/{STACK,SEQUENCER}_PRD.md` on the 10 capstone
  pages (files are `docs/prd/…`); `toneforge show --recipe <name>` on all 100
  recipe pages (command requires a positional name).

## Desired change

- Correct the link targets and the `show` command in the content generators and
  regenerate every page, `_template.md` and `index.md`.
- Add the **Working with the CLI** section to the generated index (find /
  evaluate / understand-creation) and reference it from `README.md`.
- Add machine-readable markers around capstone CLI blocks.
- Strengthen `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts`: validate CLI blocks by
  regeneration and add a link-integrity assertion across the book.
- Create and link the follow-up item for tier-aware CLI blocks
  (**TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX**, created).

## Key Files (predicted)

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — fix the invalid `show` command; keep it the single source of block text.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — fix the `show` command and the `../../tonegraph.md` link; reuse the shared block builder.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — fix `../../prd/…` links; add CLI-block markers.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` — add the **Working with the CLI** section (idempotent).
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md`, `docs/recipe-book/_template.md`, `docs/recipe-book/*.md` — regenerated output.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — real CLI freshness + link integrity.
- `README.md` — link the CLI-workflow section / confirm the book entry.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk: documentation drift.** The book is generated; a partial fix could be
  overwritten on the next run. *Mitigation:* fix the generators first, regenerate,
  and let the strengthened tests fail on any divergence.
- **Risk: scope creep.** The review will surface further opportunities (e.g.
  tier-aware blocks, richer pages). *Mitigation:* the follow-up is already
  recorded as `TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX`; new ideas become separate `discovered-from`
  items, not this scope.
- **Risk: link-checker false positives** (anchors, absolute URLs, generated
  pages). *Mitigation:* strip `#fragment`s, skip absolute/external URLs, and
  resolve targets relative to each page as the renderer would.
- **Risk: index generation is source-parsed and must stay idempotent.**
  *Mitigation:* add the new section as static generated text and assert a second
  run produces no diff.
- **Assumption:** all remaining `toneforge show`/`list`/`library`/`analyze`/
  `classify`/`explore`/`visualize` commands used in the new section run against
  the current CLI; the implementation validates them.
- **Assumption:** the audience is developers / sound designers working from the
  CLI, and this remains prose documentation (no new demo or web UI).

## Related work (manual)

- `Casual Game Recipe Book: 100 Documented Recipes from Simple to Stings (TF-0MUY9H7QZ000UX5W)` — completed parent epic that produced the book.
- `Tier-aware recipe-book CLI blocks (progressive tooling per tier) (TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX)` — follow-up created by this intake (option B deferred).
- `Sound Module Index — catalogue all modules by primary function (TF-0MV29HYZU001WUW7)` — in-flight docs index; a candidate link for the "how they were created" material.
- `docs/guides/gamedev-workflow-example.md` — precedent CLI discover→inspect→iterate guide.
- `demos/recipe-filtering.md`, `demos/library.md`, `demos/exploration.md`, `demos/classification.md`, `demos/audio-analysis.md`, `demos/machine-use.md` — existing coverage of the individual CLI surfaces.
- `docs/tonegraph.md`, `docs/guides/external-recipes.md` — recipe authoring references.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

Round 1 asked whether a new document should be created; the producer corrected
the premise — the recipe book already exists and should be reviewed/improved.

- **Q1 (round 1 — document form & location).** New `docs/guides/` guide,
  `docs/recipe-book/README.md`, extend `index.md`, or a `demos/` walkthrough?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** the book already exists
    (`index.md` + pages); **review and improve that** — do not create a new
    document.
  - Research: confirmed `docs/recipe-book/` holds `index.md`, 100 recipe pages,
    10 capstone pages and `_template.md`, generated by `scripts/recipe-book/*.ts`.
- **Q2 (round 1 — coverage).** How much of the CLI (find / evaluate / understand
  creation / capstones) should be covered?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** folded into the improve-the-book
    direction; round 2 fixed the scope.
- **Q3 (round 1 — drift protection).** Should documented commands/links be
  machine-verified?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** yes — carried into round 2 option A.
- **Q4 (round 2 — improvement scope).** (A) fix defects + add CLI-workflow
  section to the index + strengthen tests; (B) A plus tier-aware per-page CLI
  blocks; (C) defects only.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** **A**, **with a follow-up item for
    B**. Evidence: created `TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX`.
- **Q5 (round 2 — placement of the CLI-workflow content).** Extend
  `docs/recipe-book/index.md`; new `docs/recipe-book/README.md`; or
  `docs/guides/` linked from the index.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** **A — extend
    `docs/recipe-book/index.md`.**

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **TF-0MLYG5SUM0F6C40K** – Batch Generation Demo Walkthrough (completed)
- **TF-0MLYG50L81AVET0U** – CLI Help and Flag Validation (completed)
- **TF-0MM64O3VT13YE9SG** – Update library demo commentary for embedding-based similarity (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `standups/2026_10_05.md` — matched: cli, create, created, document, documentation (+11 more)
- `CHANGELOG.md` — matched: cli, create, document, documentation, find (+10 more)
- `docs/prd/DEMO_ROADMAP.md` — matched: cli, create, document, etc, evaluate (+10 more)

data.description:
Make each recipe-book page's `## ToneForge CLI` block **tier-aware**, so it demonstrates the pipeline stage appropriate to that tier instead of repeating the same four commands on all 100 pages.

**Discovered-from:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH

## Background

The parent epic `TF-0MUY9H7QZ000UX5W` (casual game recipe book) required each tier to illustrate the tooling stage appropriate to it (Tier 3 → `analyze`/`classify`/`explore`, Tier 4 → `sequence`, etc.). The delivered generator (`scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` and the duplicate in `generate-pages.ts`) emits an identical block for every recipe — `generate` ×2, `show`, `list recipes` — so the book does not teach the pipeline progessively. This was identified during the intake review of `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH` and explicitly deferred as a follow-up.

## Desired change (indicative — to be defined at intake)

- Derive the CLI block from the roster entry's `tier` (and, for capstones, the arrangement kind) so each tier shows the commands that surface its capability.
- Add machine-readable markers around capstone CLI blocks so they can be freshness-checked.
- Keep generation idempotent and extend `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` to validate the tier-specific blocks.

## Notes

This item is a follow-up and does **not** block `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH`.

## Intake — review findings & proposed improvement scope (round 2)

Confirmed: the recipe book already exists at `docs/recipe-book/` — `index.md`, 100 recipe pages, 10 capstone pages, plus `_template.md`. So this item is **review-and-improve the existing book**, not author a new document. Thank you for the correction.

### Review findings (verified against the repo)

**A. Broken relative links — 121 across 110 pages**
- `../../tonegraph.md` on 101 pages (should be `../tonegraph.md`; the file is `docs/tonegraph.md`).
- `../../prd/STACK_PRD.md` and `../../prd/SEQUENCER_PRD.md` on the 10 capstone pages each (should be `../prd/…`; files are `docs/prd/…`).
- Source: `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts`, `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts`.

**B. Invalid CLI command on all 100 recipe pages**
- Every page documents `toneforge show --recipe <name>`, which fails: `show` takes a **positional** recipe name (verified: `toneforge show blip-sine-ping` works, `show --recipe blip-sine-ping` errors).
- Source: `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` and the duplicate generator in `generate-pages.ts`.

**C. Tests let the defects through**
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` documents a "CLI-block freshness (regeneration matches the committed block)" gate, but `expectCliBlockFresh` only asserts the markers *exist* — it never regenerates and compares. There is also no link-integrity check. That is why A and B went unnoticed.

**D. Content gap against the request**
- `index.md` is a catalogue only: it has no "how to work with these sounds via the CLI" material (find → evaluate → understand how they were created).
- Every page's `## ToneForge CLI` block is identical for all 100 recipes (`generate` ×2, `show`, `list recipes`) even though the parent epic (`TF-0MUY9H7QZ000UX5W`) required **each tier to illustrate the tooling stage appropriate to it** (Tier 3 → `analyze`/`classify`/`explore`, Tier 4 → `sequence`, etc.).
- Capstone pages have no machine-readable markers around their CLI blocks, so their commands are unvalidated.

### Q1 — What should the improvement scope be?
- **A.** Fix defects (A + B), add a "Working with the CLI" section to `docs/recipe-book/index.md` covering **find / evaluate / understand-creation** with copy-paste commands, and strengthen the tests (C). Tier-aware blocks (D) treated as follow-up.
- **B.** A **plus** make per-page CLI blocks tier-aware and add evaluation commands (`analyze`, `classify`, `explore`) so each tier demonstrates its stage — larger content change.
- **C.** Defects only (A + B + C); no new user-facing content.

**Recommended:** **A** — it fixes the book's correctness problems and closes the request's "find/evaluate/how-created" gap; **B** is the natural follow-up if you want the per-page blocks to teach the pipeline rather than repeat.

### Q2 — Where should the "how to work with the CLI" content live?
- **A.** In `docs/recipe-book/index.md` (extend the generated index with a "How to use this book" section).
- **B.** A separate `docs/recipe-book/README.md`.
- **C.** In the existing `docs/guides/` area, linked from the index.

**Recommended:** **A** — keeps everything about the 100-sound library in one place and answers your "reviewing/improving the book" direction.

**Assumption carried until confirmed:** the fixes are applied to the **generators** and the pages regenerated (not hand-edited), so the book stays reproducible and the new tests keep it honest.

_Answers pending; flagged for producer review._
